title: Robust Bayesian Inference via Variational Approximations of Generalized Rho-Posteriors
summary: We introduce the $\widetildeρ$-posterior, a modified version of the $ρ$-posterior, obtained by replacing the supremum over competitor parameters with a softmax aggregation. This modification allows a PAC-Bayesian analysis of the $\widetildeρ$-posterior. This yields finite-sample oracle inequalities with explicit convergence rates that inherit the key robustness properties of the original framework, in particular, graceful degradation under model misspecification and data contamination.
